model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, with values presented as percentages of the sector in the total economy and absolute values by NACE Rev. 2. Each chart is divided into four colored segments corresponding to the sectors: industry (brown), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue), as indicated by the legend below. The leftmost chart, labeled “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,” shows industry accounting for 61% (19.0 million enterprises), other services for 19% (5.9 million), trade for 12% (3.7 million), and construction for 8% (2.4 million). The middle chart, “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,” shows other services at 51% (80.2 million persons), industry at 21% (33.0 million), trade at 19% (29.5 million), and construction at 9% (13.4 million). The rightmost chart, “TURNOVER,” shows industry at 33% (10.6 trillion), other services at 31% (9.9 trillion), and trade at 31% (9.8 trillion), while construction accounts for 6% (1.9 trillion). All segments are labeled with their respective percentage and absolute value, and the charts are arranged side by side with no visual emphasis on any particular segment. The legend is positioned below the charts, providing the color coding for each sector.
